setting_github_token_description: A read-only token. A classic token with read:org works for public repositories; private ones also need repository read access. If the org uses SSO, authorize the token for it.
setting_repositories_description: One owner/repo per line. "/review 1234" uses the first one; for the others, use repo#1234 or the PR URL.
setting_target_room_description: Where the cards are posted. For a private room, add the app user to it first.
setting_webhook_token_description: Any random text. Put it at the end of the webhook URL in GitHub as ?token=<secret>.
setting_webhook_active_description: On: GitHub updates the cards as things happen, and the app also checks GitHub once an hour. Off: the app checks GitHub every 5 minutes.
setting_user_links_description: One pair per line: rocketchat-username github-login. Linked people are mentioned on the cards and can use Take it. Others show as their GitHub login.
setting_not_available_description: People to skip when reviewers are drawn, for example during time off. One GitHub login per line. Add "until YYYY-MM-DD" to skip someone only until that day. You can still name them with /review or Reassign.
setting_group_teams: One reviewer can cover several teams
setting_group_teams_description: On: a person in more than one of the PR's teams covers all of them, so fewer people get pinged. Off: each team gets its own reviewer when someone else is available.
setting_draw_strategy_description: Balanced: the person with the fewest open reviews, then whoever covers more of the PR's teams, then someone not picked recently. Random: anyone in the team.
